topic: Transit analytics data regeneration and review
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on generating and adjusting various datasets for Transit Analytics. Initially, [p1] requested two test runs for company 7894: one covering a 1-hour interval and another covering a 2-hour interval, to allow for data comparison.

[me] subsequently generated the required datasets (model1 & model2) with the specified session gaps. Later, [p1] requested changes for company 7880 at facility 4349: recalibration to 74 on the stage and recalculation of history starting from 2022-08-15.

Discussion arose regarding running recalculations for only a single sensor. [me] advised that doing so would likely result in incorrect data, recommending that calculations always be performed for the entire company scope instead. This was accepted by [p1].
decisions: Two test datasets for Transit Analytics were created for company 7894 (1-hour and 2-hour session gaps).
For company 7880 at facility 4349, the calibration was changed to 74 on the stage, and history recalculation was initiated from 2022-08-15.
action_items: Follow up on the scheduled discussion regarding Germany (at 13:30).
